newsitem.title: USA: More data sought on Ford sale - report.
newsitem.headline: More data sought on Ford sale - report.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Justice has asked for more information on Freightliner Corp's proposed purchase of Ford Motor Co's heavy truck business, the trade newsletter Stark's Truck & Off-Highway Ledger said on Sunday.

The report said the Department asked Freightliner, a unit of Germany's Daimler-Benz AG, for more information on the deal. It said Freightliner declined to speculate on the length of time it would take to gather the data needed.
There was no answer at Freightliner's offices in Portland, Oregon, Sunday.

A Ford spokesman said a request for information was made the week before last, but that it was expected and not unusual. "We don't regard it as anything out of the ordinary," spokesman Mike Jarvis said.
Jarvis said he did not have further details on the request and that Ford did not expect the request to delay the transaction, which was announced in February.
